en.title: Resilient pinned Windows toolchain preparation
en.body: M0 prepares one verified PowerShell archive for Windows and all four test shards, with exact cache reuse, run-local artifact reuse, alternate release transport, optional managed HTTPS mirror and bounded retries. Fixed toolchain verification and protected merge checks remain required.

zh.title: 增强固定 Windows 工具链准备的可靠性
zh.body: M0 统一准备一个经校验的 PowerShell 归档供 Windows 主检查和四个测试分片复用，支持精确缓存、本次运行产物、备用发行传输路径、可选 HTTPS 自管镜像及有界重试。固定工具链校验和保护合并检查保持必需。
